g.text: In this book's simulation, check points between steps cut wrong final actions and rework, at the cost of more of a person's time

text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Simulated by this book (figures/scripts/ch14_experiments.py): 20 steps, 95% per step, a person catching a wrong result 80% of the time (open markers: 50%);

text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 10 seeds × 20,000 runs. Assumes independent steps and misses, no false alarms, no approval fatigue, only the final action irreversible. Not data about any agent.
